question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and military apparatus following his 2022 third term, with no verified signs of imminent removal through 2026. Official activities, policy directives on national security and technological self-reliance, and preparations for the 2027 Party Congress all point to expectations of a further term. Trader consensus at 95.5% against an exit before 2027 reflects the absence of credible succession signals, institutional consolidation, and dismissal of earlier health or factional rumors as unsubstantiated. Rare shifts could arise from an abrupt medical event, unforeseen elite realignment ahead of the congress, or external shocks altering internal dynamics, though current evidence shows no such trajectory.
